g.text: No session id, messages, selected model,
queue, active run, cancellation, or trace.
Current Java Agent remains per Session.
It is never stored in the Template cache.
The long-term Runner has no current
Session or current Run instance field.
A newer resume increments the per-Pod generation.
The previous connection closes with 4409 SESSION_REPLACED.
Disconnect does not own or abort an active Run.
No target Session JSONL is generated.
Only completed content blocks are recoverable.
